result.summary: This PR reverts #36057, which had added a configure-time check for SetThreadDescription() on Windows, since the project has now branched for 33.x and can assume a mingw-w64 version (12.0+) that always has this symbol. It also documents the mingw-w64 12.0 requirement in doc/build-windows.md, and simplifies contrib/devtools/shell-win64-cross.nix and depends/README.md by dropping the now-unsupported MSVCRT cross-build path in favor of UCRT only.
result.problem: The prior PR (#36057) added complexity to work around old mingw-w64 headers lacking SetThreadDescription, but this workaround becomes unnecessary once the project's minimum supported mingw-w64 is raised past 12.0 for the new release cycle. Leaving the check and the MSVCRT build path in place adds needless build-system surface area for maintainers of Windows cross-compilation.

resolved_concerns: maflcko suggested also removing the leftover UCRT-specific HOST env var logic in depends/README.md and the nix file; fanquake implemented it in a follow-up push ('Sure, dropped.')

result.card: This PR reverts #36057 (a configure-time check for SetThreadDescription on mingw-w64) now that the project has branched for the 33.x release and can assume mingw-w64 12.0+, and documents that minimum version requirement in doc/build-windows.md. It also drops the now-unsupported MSVCRT cross-build path from the nix cross-compile shell script and depends/README.md, simplifying the Windows cross-compilation build tooling. The change is low-risk cleanup tied to an agreed plan referenced by hebasto's concept ACK ('This follows the plan'), with ViniciusCestarii also ACKing and no objections. The PR is Ready to review; a reviewer nit from maflcko about leftover UCRT logic was already addressed in a follow-up push. It depends on #36057 having merged and the 33.x branch point having occurred.
